mechanism: gonadotropin releasing factor hormone receptor agonist

hypothesis.mechanism: gonadotropin releasing factor hormone receptor agonist
context_requirements: Expression of GNRHR or LHCGR on the cell surface
An intact Gq/11-phospholipase C signaling axis
Cell lineages derived from gonadotroph, placental, or gonadal tissue for robust transcriptional output
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of immediate-early genes such as FOS, JUN, EGR1, or ATF3 at 6 h in any of the nine lines
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 10 micromolar that are absent in GNRHR/LHCGR-negative lines but present in receptor-positive lines
Consistent regulation of a shared gene set across multiple lines at 24 h
